transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... hi. I guess... well, I'm just having some trouble settling down. Like, I feel like I can’t really settle in my own body anymore. It's mostly when I’m supposed to just sit quietly and do things like paperwork, or... go over shared household plans. I just... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Do you find yourself moving around a lot, fidgeting, or feeling restless when you’re trying to sit still?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... like, if I'm at a family dinner, or... a church meeting. I try really hard to just look composed, but... I'm usually twisting my wedding ring. Or bouncing my foot. Just... shifting around in the chair a lot, I suppose.
Does this restlessness happen in other situations too, like when you're alone or just trying to relax by yourself?

I suppose so. Um... sometimes I just want to sit quietly and read next to my husband in the evening. But... I don't know, I guess I end up humming, or talking, or just getting up to grab little things. It just... doesn't stay very peaceful for long.
Do you also find yourself feeling uneasy or worried when you're trying to sit still, like your mind is racing or you can't quiet your thoughts?

No, I wouldn't say that. Um... I don't really feel worried. It's just... I just have a hard time staying still, that's all. My mind isn't necessarily racing with bad thoughts or anything. I just... I just want to move.
Do you also have trouble staying still or feel restless in other situations, like at work, in meetings, or when you're by yourself doing something that requires focus?
I mean... I don't work right now, so I don't really have meetings. Um... if I'm doing something that takes focus, I guess... I don't know, I just don't always stay in one spot.
Can you think of any time when you were able to sit still and feel calm, like during a movie, a long car ride, or even waiting in a doctor’s office? How did that go for you?
I don't know... I guess movies are okay sometimes. Um... car rides are fine, I usually just look out the window. I don't really remember how doctor's offices go. It's just... normal, I suppose.
When you're in situations where you're expected to stay still, like during a movie or a car ride, do you ever feel sudden waves of anxiety or panic, or a strong urge to leave the situation?
No... not really. I don't get panic attacks or anything like that. I just... I might shift around or get up if I can, but I don't feel anxious about it.
Have you noticed any changes in your mood lately, like feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
No, not really. I mean... I feel fine, mostly. Just... normal, I guess. I haven't really noticed feeling down or anything like that.
Do you also feel restless or have trouble staying still when you're by yourself at home, maybe when you're watching TV or trying to fall asleep?
I don't really know. I guess I move around a bit, but... it's just normal for me. I haven't really paid attention to it.
Looking back, did you have similar feelings of restlessness or trouble staying still when you were a child or teenager?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... even back in elementary school, I think. I was... well, my desk was always a mess. And I'd forget things, like permission slips. I remember teachers sending notes home saying I talked out of turn or... couldn't stay in my seat. So... yeah, it's not new.
Has this restlessness or trouble staying still ever caused you any problems with your family, household responsibilities, or personal goals?

I suppose so. Um... people at home, or even when I try to volunteer... they can't really count on me. I end up letting things fall through, even when I'm trying not to. So... I've just had to step back from some of those responsibilities. It's just... easier that way.
Do you ever find yourself making repeated, purposeless movements, like hand-waving, rocking, or repetitive finger movements, especially when you're feeling stressed or trying to focus?
No, I don't think so. I mean... I don't really do anything like that. Just... normal fidgeting, maybe. But not like waving my hands around or anything.
Do you ever feel like your body feels tense or agitated, like you can't relax even if you're not moving around?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I get tense like that. It's mostly just... having a hard time sitting still, I guess. But not... agitated.
Do you ever feel worried or anxious about not being able to sit still or stay calm in certain situations?
I don't... I wouldn't say I get worried about it. I just... I know it happens, but I don't really sit around feeling anxious about it. It just is what it is.
Can you tell me more about how you were in school? Like, did you have trouble paying attention, finishing assignments, or staying in your seat?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Looking back, it was already like that back in elementary school. I was just... the girl with the really messy desk. I'd forget permission slips a lot. And... my teachers would write notes home saying I talked out of turn, or... that I couldn't stay in my seat. So... yeah.
